outline: 本課程介紹大數據在各個領域決策制定的應用，課程內容包括大數據分析與應用、大數據管理、大數據分法與策略、資料探勘介紹、資料探勘方法、大數據平台、大數據行銷實務、大數據個案分析、期末專題製作與報告。學生可以經由多個案例學習大數據的應用實務、目前技術與未來發展方向。
schedule:
Part I: Data mining concepts  (6 wks)
1. Introduction to big data concepts & data preprocessing (1 wk)
2. Frequent pattern mining (2 wks)
3. Data classification (2 wks)
4. Data clustering (1 wk)

Midterm exam (1 wk)

Part II: Distributed processing (5 wks)

1. Introduction to distributed platforms: Hadoop & Spark  (1 wk)
2. Configuration & setup: Hadoop & Spark (1 wk)
3. MapReduce programming: relational algebra, pairs & stripes (1 wk)
4. Case study of Spark programming: frequent itemset, classification, clustering (2 wks)
assessment:
Homework assignments and programming exercises: ~30-35%
Mid-term exam: ~25-30%
